mappingVerification.method: Transitive closure of every exported object type, Blueprint/native superclass, and embedded StructProperty (including array/set/map value structures). Object references are not loaded as property payloads. No selected type reaches a changed OptionalProperty.
mappingVerification.hashMeaning: SHA-256 of provider.SaveAsset(path) raw package bytes after container decompression; localization hashes likewise identify raw locres bytes. These are not JSON export hashes.

evidence.comment: Default slot size for the production boost power shards. This is the default for all buildables that do not have an override.
Whenever this buildable has a custom value for Production Shard Slot Size

resolution: canBoost=false => 0; override=true => class mProductionShardSlotSize; override=false => subsystem mDefaultProductionShardSlotSize. Smelter has canBoost=True and override=False in pinned Docs; effective slots=1.
